item.title: Fresh off a record $3 billion CMU pledge, Ken Griffin sends Pittsburgh 3 dinosaurs and $5 million
item.description:
【AI 精简版】 AI-condensed version. This text was produced by an LLM from the original article and may omit details. The original link at the end is the only authoritative source.

Ken Griffin, CEO of Citadel, donated $3 billion to Carnegie Mellon University and lent three dinosaur fossils to the Carnegie Museum of Natural History. The fossils, discovered in Wyoming, include an adult and two juvenile Diplodocus carnegii. Griffin also donated $5 million for paleontological research and a new fossil-preparation lab. The fossils will be displayed publicly, and the donation supports educational programming.

Source: Fortune | Published: 2026-11-20 12:16 UTC

Original link: https://fortune.com/2026/11/20/ken-griffin-dinosaur-fossils-carnegie-museum-pittsburgh/
